# regapi_domain (Data Source)

Reads a domain registered in the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "regapi_domain" "client" {
  name = "client.gr"
}

output "expires" {
  value = data.regapi_domain.client.expiry_date
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain name.

### Read-Only

- `admin_contact_id` (String) Contact ID of the administrative contact.
- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Auto-renew.
- `billing_contact_id` (String) Contact ID of the billing contact.
- `expiry_date` (String) Expiry date and time.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Nameservers.
- `nameservers_source` (String) default or custom.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase.
- `registrant_contact_id` (String) Contact ID of the registrant.
- `tech_contact_id` (String) Contact ID of the technical contact.
